about: shard-showcase's land settings (meta WORKTREE-LAND-STANDARD WL4; keys in scripts/land.mjs). shard-showcase is public, so its hosted Actions run: land waits for the exact plan/<slug> SHA's `ci` push run (its one `check` job: pnpm check and the hook tests; showcase has no Ring 2 job, so no plan-vs-main compare). pnpm's frozen install after a dependency rebase; no TS10 flaky quarantine.
